title: Elastic BB knots are multifold circles
summary: We study elastic knots obtained by minimizing the bending energy of a unit loop together with a small multiple of ropelength. We assume a generalized Fáry-Milnor inequality on the $C^1$-boundary of a knot class: every $H^2$-limit curve in the $C^1$-closure has total curvature at least $2π$ times the bridge index. Under this assumption we prove that every elastic knot in a one-component BB knot class, that is, a class whose bridge and braid indices coincide, is the round circle covered precisely that many times.
